{{Top|leg}}
'''Oma'gorek''' was a [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who sought to obtain the complete armor set of the famous hero [[Kaellus Fane]]. Oma'gorek hired outside help to locate the gauntlets that he was missing from the set, which were found in a scrapyard where they were about to be incinerated.
